decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express delivery program is close to the firm's existing production-planning and customer-service capabilities, and its continued website presence across 2023 and 2024 suggests the firm can absorb feedback and run it as a viable service add-on.

The seventy-two-hour express delivery program also fits the firm's operational knowledge base, but its higher execution strain makes it somewhat more vulnerable than slower express offers even though it remained visible in both years.

A dedicated express delivery program for doors and gates is tightly linked to the firm's core product knowledge and, with its own page in both 2023 and 2024, appears to be a strategically retained and learnable extension of the established business.

The online ordering and digital services platform complements the firm's existing sales and fulfilment processes, and a dedicated page in both years indicates ongoing investment and sufficient absorptive capacity to improve and integrate it commercially.

The fire and smoke protection door is highly related to the firm's metal-fabrication and regulated door expertise, and its upgrade from a mention in 2023 to a standalone page in 2024 signals successful learning and strengthening market commitment.
